notes.title: Final Update: Hometopia's Development Ends
notes.notes:
Dear Topians,

We want to start by saying thank you—truly—for being part of the Hometopia journey. Your creativity and support have meant the world to our small team.

After an incredible run, we’ve made the very difficult decision to end active development and live operations for Hometopia. While we had bigger dreams for it, funding constraints mean this is the final version. Our team is no longer able to support updates, bug fixes, or new features. 

That said, Hometopia will remain live and fully playable for anyone who owns it—and starting April 2, we’re offering it at a legacy discount of $8.99 so even more players can experience what the community helped build. This is our way of preserving the game and giving fans a chance to enjoy it on their own terms. 

Starting April 2, Hometopia will enter “Legacy Mode”:

 All current content will remain playable
 The game will continue to be available on Steam
 No further updates, bug fixes, or technical support will be provided
 Community spaces like the Steam forums and Hometopia Discord will remain open for players to connect and share; however we will revisit this policy if the Discord becomes overwhelmed with spam or toxic content


We heard you in the reviews, discord and discussions that pulling career mode out during development has frustrated many of you. Career mode is still available to play in an older version of the game.  If you'd like to revisit the old Career Mode, just follow these simple steps:

1. Right-click Hometopia in your Steam library
2. Select Properties
3. Go to Betas
4. Choose "Hometopia Old Career Mode" from the dropdown menu

We know this news may be disappointing—it is for us too. We poured our hearts into Hometopia and dreamed of building it alongside you for years to come. While this chapter is coming to a close, we’re proud of what we created, and even prouder of the community that formed around it.

Thank you for building with us. Thank you for dreaming with us. We hope to create something new together again someday.

— The Hometopia Game Dev Team

notes.title: Hometopia Update #2: Sandbox Mode and Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Hey Topians,

We're thrilled to announce a highly anticipated addition to Hometopia in Update #2 – Sandbox Mode! Get ready to unleash your creativity and take your home designs to a whole new level. In addition to Sandbox Mode, we have some other updates (including optimizations) that will be explained in detail in the patch notes below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/714d08375c57f610ebb944e7fb8a2c62d2ad89d7.jpg
What is Sandbox Mode?

Sandbox Mode is an additional game mode in Hometopia that lets you design your dream homes with unlimited resources and complete creative freedom. There are no budget constraints or locked inventory items - build, decorate, and experiment to your heart's content.

Key Features:

-Unlimited Resources: Access to an endless supply of funds, materials, and furniture to bring your wildest design ideas to life.
-Build in Multiplayer: Team up with up to 4 friends to build without limitations, all in real-time collaboration.
-No Scoring: There are no client requirements in Sandbox! Your house, your rules.
-Experiment and Learn: Try out new design techniques, layouts, and decor styles without any consequences.
-Show Off Your Creativity: Participate in our creative challenges in Discord, showcase your designs, and get inspired by others in the Hometopia community.

Now, let's take a quick look at what other fixes are included in this update:

Patch Notes:

Gameplay

-NEW MODE: Sandbox - accessible from the title screen
-Starter home/tutorial house: fixed sink incorrectly rotated 180 degrees
-Version numbering simplified

Performance

-Across-the-board optimizations. Tons of performance issues, small and large, have been fixed and overall performance should be 10-60% better, depending on system configuration
-Painting performance has been improved
-Painting walls or floors should be much faster and cause less lag than previously

Graphics

-New and improved skyscrapers in Midtown Heights
-Neighborhood houses have been reworked with more variety in Plaza Lakes and Midtown Heights
-Grass visibility range has been increased and optimized
-Washer dryer combo texture/model fixed
-Lights can once again pass through windows and doors
-Updated shadows (higher quality, less jagged, less light leak)
-Overblown light from candles fixed

Known Issues

-Grass/ground coloration in some neighborhoods appears wrong or misaligned due to terrain optimization work- will be patched soon.
-A section of The Gables neighborhood has a grassy area on the street - we aren't sure why the HOA decided to seed the road, but mowers will be sent in a patch soon.


Thank you for your continued support as we upgrade the game, and we can't wait to see the amazing creations you'll come up with in Sandbox Mode.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and features. And as a reminder, if you love Hometopia, leave a review!

Happy building, The Hometopia Team 🏠✨

notes.title: Launch Error Update Including Unity2022.3.8f1_b5eafc012955 Error
notes.notes:
Hi Topians!

The following error has been appearing at launch for some of our players:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/ab67c064a8d7e2ce32785761f21c4c7417850ac4.png

We understand this is frustrating to experience and wanted to make sure that we communicate why this is happening. This error occurs 95% of the time because the computer specs do not meet the minimum requirements for Hometopia at this time.

We are in Early Access and working really hard to optimize for more systems, but, for the time being, these are our minimum specs:

Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions)
Processor: Intel Core 8th gen
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 4GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 10 GB available space

How to check if your computer meets the specs:

Click on the Windows Start button, then click on Settings (the gear icon). In the Settings menu, click on System. Scroll down and click on About. (You must meet all requirements, including the dedicated graphics card, to play Hometopia at this time.)

If you have further questions, please feel free to reach out on Discord. (Join here: https://discord.gg/hometopia-604380109109198850) Please be sure to include your specific system details, so that we can better understand and address compatibility issues going forward.

If you are receiving this error, you may want to consider submitting a refund request. We hope you’ll revisit Hometopia once we've optimized for more system configurations!

notes.title: 10 Game-Changing Features Awaiting You in Hometopia’s Early Access Release

notes.title: Hometopia Developer Update
notes.notes:
The time has come for an update on development and for us to open a window into some awesome new features that we’re excited to be sharing with you!

This will be the first of many updates, but to get the ball rolling this post will showcase a snippet into one of the more underrated features of a property, yet incredibly vital, the windows! Now you may be thinking that windows can’t be all that exciting but get a load of this…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/2d696b3dd0c3e8d07a17c8a74dd898bcd76a0902.gif

One standout feature concerning our windows is how they react with the outside world, if the window is in the direct path of the sun, then rays of sunshine will shimmer through the window creating a visible beam of light, making even the smallest dust particles sparkle. However on the other hand, if a window isn't in the direct path of the sun, the game will still produce realistic levels of indirect lighting, ensuring that the room is still sufficiently lit.

There’s a whole world outside of the walls of your property in which you’ll be free to fill the sky with the golden glow of a sunset or a cold darkness, all by manipulating time within the time of day wheel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/a3dac09219e017f6aaceeecea030afbca519fe95.gif

If you happen to be a fan of fresh air and beautiful sunsets, then renovating and designing properties will be a breeze as you’ll be able to freely place windows anywhere on a wall that you desire, all whilst creating dynamic lighting and shadows. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/9d74ff5bff65b72937cc7467d823fbcbe76becfa.jpg

Our large catalog of windows can be interacted with to either open or close at will, in both the overview and first person camera mode. With a vast range of windows at your disposal, you’ll be able to let your creativity flow and create the properties of your wildest dreams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/df035540c31a69a6331414e9caae947e541f98c5.gif

The lighting magic doesn't stop there though, as to ensure the visual experience is as similar as possible to the real world, lights will react differently depending on the surface and texture type, making it easier to create the most mesmerizing scenes and renovations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312004/f1b220f99286cd2f060bb42bb25ad09f5dcee8a6.gif

We also wanted to give you an update on the launch time frame of the game. We are aware that it is no longer Q2 2020 which is our current Steam launch window, as many of you have suspected we will not be launching the game in 2020. We are working hard on the games development and making it the best possible version it can be. We can update you all and let you know the game will be launching in 2021. Once we have a better idea of the window we will update that too - for now we will continue to keep these development blogs coming so you have an insight into development! Thanks everyone for your continued support on the project!
